request.content:
# Accessibility

**Target:** WCAG 2.2 **AA** for the whole product; AAA for body text on the primary
reading surfaces (chat, docs) where it is cheap to achieve.

**Status:** partially met. The patterns that exist are good (semantic roles, visible
focus recipes, reduced motion, 44px mobile targets); the gaps are concentrated in
overlays, contrast and streaming content.

---

## 1. Conformance checklist (what "done" means)

| # | Requirement | Target | Current |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | Body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 | both themes | ❌ magenta text on dark is 3.1:1 |
| 1.2 | Large text / UI components ≥ 3:1 | both themes | ⚠️ mostly, verify per screen |
| 1.3 | Non-text contrast (borders, icons, focus) ≥ 3:1 | both themes | ⚠️ `base-content/10` borders are ~1.2:1 (intentional hairline, but not a control boundary) |
| 2.1 | Full keyboard operation | all screens | ⚠️ board drag & drop is pointer-only |
| 2.2 | Visible focus indicator everywhere | all screens | ⚠️ present on newer components, missing on older ones |
| 2.3 | No keyboard trap; overlays trap *and release* focus | dialogs, sheets | ❌ modal has no trap and never restores focus |
| 2.4 | Logical focus order matching visual order | dockview + mobile sheets | ⚠️ unverified |
| 3.1 | Programmatic names for every control | all | ⚠️ icon-only buttons inconsistent (`title` instead of `aria-label`) |
| 3.2 | Status messages announced without focus | toasts, streaming | ❌ no `aria-live` |
| 3.3 | Language declared | `index.html` | ✅ `lang="en"` |
| 4.1 | Reduced motion honoured | all animations | ✅ mobile shell; ⚠️ not global |
| 4.2 | Touch targets ≥ 24×24 (2.2 AA) / 44×44 (product standard) | mobile | ✅ 44px in the mobile shell |
| 4.3 | Zoom to 200% / reflow without horizontal page scroll | both | ⚠️ dense tables scroll horizontally by design (acceptable: `overflow-x` on the container) |
| 4.4 | No meaning conveyed by colour alone | status, diffs, tabs | ✅ mostly (dot + label, add/remove prefixes) |
| 4.5 | Streaming output accessible while it changes | chat | ❌ not announced, not pausable |

---

## 2. Contrast — the concrete fixes

Full measurements are in `01-brand/color-system.md` §5. The actionable rules:

| Situation | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Magenta text on the dark canvas | Use `#FF69B4` (5.5:1) or the OKLCH-boosted primary `oklch(65% 0.32 320)`. **Do not** use `#CC0099` as text on dark. |
| Purple `#8F008F` on dark | Never as text (1.8:1). Gradient stops and chart fills only. |
| White text on pink `#FF69B4` | Fails (2.0:1). Use ink `#111827` on pink, or magenta fill with white text (4.8:1). |
| Inactive mobile tab label (`text-base-content/50` on `bg-base-200/95`) | Raise to `/70`. Small text at 10px needs all the contrast it can get. |
| Placeholder text | Minimum `/55` on the field surface — placeholders must be readable, and must never be the only label. |
| Divider borders | Hairlines are decorative; **controls** (inputs, buttons, checkboxes) need ≥ 3:1 against their background. |

Implement as a token decision, not per-component: `--color-primary` **differs per theme**
(light `#CC0099`, dark `oklch(65% 0.32 320)`). That single change fixes most instances at
once, because components already use `text-primary`.

---

## 3. Keyboard & focus

### Required map (document it in-product with `?` shortcut help)

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Move focus |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Activate |
| `Escape` | Close the topmost overlay, cancel an inline edit |
| `←` `→` `↑` `↓` | Move within a tablist, list or board |
| `Ctrl/Cmd+K` | Command palette / global search |
| `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` | Send message |
| `Ctrl/Cmd+S` | Save the focused editor |
| `?` | Keyboard shortcuts dialog |

### Dialog focus contract (implement in `Modal.vue`)

1. On open: focus the first focusable element (or the dialog container if none).
2. `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` cycle **inside** the dialog.
3. `Escape` closes (already implemented).
4. On close: focus returns to the element that opened it.
5. `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` → title id.
6. Background is inert (`aria-hidden` on the app root, or the focus trap alone).

The same contract applies to `MobileActionSheet`, `ChatNavigatorDrawer`, `ProfileDrawer`
and the mobile launcher.

### Board (kanban) keyboard operation

Pointer-only drag is a 2.1 failure. Minimum viable keyboard path:

- `Tab` into a card → `Enter` opens it (this already works via the card link).
- `Ctrl/Cmd + ←/→` on a focused card moves it to the previous/next column.
- Moving must announce the result (`aria-live`: "Moved to In progress").

---

## 4. Screen-reader requirements per surface

| Surface | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Chat | Message list is a `log` / `feed`; author and role are announced (`aria-label="codx-junior said"`); streaming text uses `aria-live="polite"` with a **pause** control |
| Tool / step trace | Each step is a list item with its state in text (`running`, `done`, `failed`) — never icon-only |
| Board | Columns are `role="list"`, cards are list items with the status in text; counts announced |
| Tables | Real `<table>`/`<th scope>`; sort state via `aria-sort` |
| Tabs | `role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel"`, `aria-selected`, roving `tabindex` (tab bar already does this) |
| Diffs | Add/remove conveyed by prefix characters and text, not only by green/red |
| Live views (VNC browser) | An accessible alternative summary of what the agent is doing — the canvas is opaque to assistive tech |
| Toasts | `aria-live="polite"`, `role="status"`; errors `role="alert"` |
| Icons | Decorative → `aria-hidden="true"`; meaningful → `aria-label` |

---

## 5. Motion, timing and flashing

- Minimum transition duration `150ms`, maximum `300ms` (except the mobile sheet
  `240ms` curve). No animation over `400ms`.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables transforms **globally**, not only in the
  mobile shell (today: `base.css` covers the mobile shell only).
- No flashing above 3 Hz. Spinners are the only infinite loops allowed.
- Streaming text must not auto-scroll if the user has scrolled up (respect manual scroll
  position — partially implemented in the chat scroller; make it a rule).
- Auto-dismissing toasts: `3000ms`, **paused on hover and on focus** (hover is
  implemented; focus is not).

---

## 6. Mobile specifics

- Minimum target `44×44px`, gap `8px` (product standard, above the 24px AA minimum).
- Inputs are `16px` minimum to prevent iOS zoom (already enforced by `base.css`).
- Safe areas respected: `env(safe-area-inset-top/bottom)` — used by the tab bar and
  toasts; must also apply to full-screen modals and bottom sheets.
- Landscape: the shell must remain usable at `667×375`; the tab bar must not overlap the
  composer.
- No hover-only affordances: row actions that appear on hover must be permanently
  visible on touch.

---

## 7. Testing protocol (per release)

1. **Automated:** Lighthouse accessibility ≥ 90 on Home, Chat, Board, Settings (both
   themes, desktop + mobile).
2. **Keyboard-only:** complete F1 (ask → result) and F2 (board move) without a mouse.
3. **Screen reader:** one pass with NVDA (Windows) or VoiceOver (macOS) over Chat and
   Board.
4. **Zoom/reflow:** 200% at 1280px; 320px width (reflow) without page-level horizontal
   scroll.
5. **Contrast:** automated pass on the token pairs listed in `color-system.md` §5.
6. **Reduced motion:** enable the OS setting; confirm no transform/transition runs.

Record results in the release notes; regressions block release.

---

## 8. Definition of Done for a component

- [ ] All states keyboard-reachable and focus-visible.
- [ ] `aria-*` correct (role, name, state) and verified with one screen reader.
- [ ] Contrast verified in **both** themes for text, borders of controls, icons and focus.
- [ ] Colour is never the only carrier of meaning.
- [ ] Touch target ≥ 44px on mobile.
- [ ] Motion respects reduced-motion.
- [ ] Announced when it appears, changes or fails (`aria-live` where relevant).

# Asset Guidelines

How brand assets are produced, named and exported — for product, docs, decks, social
and partner use.

---

## 1. Folder layout (create as assets land)

```
design/04-assets/
  logo/            vector lockups, glyph, colour variants (see 01-brand/logo-system.md)
  app-icons/       favicon set, PWA icons, store icons
  social/          OG image, LinkedIn/X cards, avatar
  product/         curated product screenshots (both themes, desktop + mobile)
  diagrams/        SVG architecture/flow diagrams
  templates/       deck, one-pager, doc header (source + export)
  fonts/           self-hosted webfonts, if a licensed face is adopted
```

Nothing goes in `client/public/` until it exists here first. `client/public/` is a
build artifact location, not an asset library.

---

## 2. Formats & rules

| Type | Master | Delivered | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logo | `.svg` (editable source + optimised export) | `.svg`, `.png` | Inline `fill`, no `<style>`, no embedded raster, no text-as-path unless the wordmark is fixed |
| Icons (product) | Font Awesome set (already vendored) | — | Do not add a second icon library per surface |
| Screenshots | PNG 2× (retina) | PNG or WebP | No device frames, no fake browser chrome, no blur |
| Illustrations | SVG | SVG/PNG | Line work, magenta family, dark canvas |
| Diagrams | Mermaid (in docs) or SVG | SVG | Consistent node styling, mono labels |
| Photography | — | — | **Not used.** No stock photography in the corporate image |
| Video | MP4/H.264 | MP4 + poster PNG | ≤ 30s loops, no audio, captions if spoken |

Naming: `codx-junior-<subject>-<variant>-<size>.<ext>`, lowercase, hyphenated,
no spaces, no dates. Examples:

```
codx-junior-logo-primary.svg
codx-junior-glyph-512.png
codx-junior-og-1200x630.png
codx-junior-screenshot-chat-dark-2x.png
codx-junior-screenshot-board-light-2x.png
codx-junior-diagram-harness-run.svg
```

---

## 3. Product screenshots (the primary marketing asset)

Because the product *is* the visual, screenshots carry the brand. Rules:

1. **Real product, real data.** No lorem ipsum, no `test test test`, no placeholder
   avatars. Use a believable project ("codx-junior platform", real file names).
2. **Both themes**, but dark is the hero shot.
3. **Window edges:** capture the app viewport only — no OS chrome, no rounded device
   frames, no drop shadows added afterwards.
4. **Crop to the story.** One screenshot = one message (chat streaming, board with
   sprint, diff review, live browser with handover).
5. **Redact** tokens, API keys, emails and personal names before publishing.
6. Export at 2× and let the consumer downscale; never upscale.
7. Keep a source set in `design/04-assets/product/` plus a manifest with the route used
   to reproduce each shot.

Current usable material: `docs/public/images/NOV2025/*.png` (banner, desktop, kanban,
profiles, pull request, knowledge, models) and `.mobile-preview/screenshots/01–10.png`.
They should be re-shot against the token-based theme once it ships — the current shots
show the untokened palette.

---

## 4. Avatars & user imagery

| Case | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Real user | Their uploaded image |
| No image | **Initials on `brand.magenta.600`** (white, 600 weight) — deterministic from the name |
| AI profile | Glyph mark on `surface.overlay` with a 1px `border.default`, or the profile's own avatar |
| Partner/brand | Monochrome version of their mark, equal optical weight |
| Never | Third-party avatar generators (today: `api.dicebear.com`), emoji faces, stock portraits |

---

## 5. Iconography assets

- Source of truth: `client/src/assets/fontawesome-free-6.5.1-web` (FA 6.5.1 Free).
- App-level icons live in the registries (`config/apps.js`, `config/mobile.js`) as
  class strings — they are **design decisions**, so changes to them go through this
  folder's review, not a drive-by commit.
- For brand marks FA lacks (GitHub is present; marketplace logos may not be), export an
  optimised SVG into `design/04-assets/icons/` and consume it as a component.

---

## 6. Imagery don'ts (corporate image protection)

- ❌ Robotic hands, glowing brains, neural-network stock art, "AI orbs", 3D blobs.
- ❌ Purple-blue gradients unrelated to the magenta ramp (the "AI product" cliché).
- ❌ Memoji / mascots of any kind.
- ❌ Screenshots with invented features that do not exist in the product.
- ❌ Partner logos of unequal optical weight or with recoloured brand colours.
- ❌ Light-mode screenshots used to represent a dark-first product.

---

## 7. Export specs by channel

| Channel | Spec |
| --- | --- |
| Favicon | `favicon.ico` 16/32/48 + `favicon.svg` |
| Apple touch icon | 180×180 PNG, no transparency, radius baked 22.5% |
| PWA | 192 and 512 PNG (+ `maskable` 512 with 20% safe padding) |
| OG / link preview | 1200×630 PNG, logo top-left, one-line claim, dark canvas |
| GitHub social | 1280×640 PNG |
| Docs header | 1600×400 PNG or SVG, dark canvas |
| Deck | 16:9, title slide = logo on dark canvas, no image collage |
| Email signature | Horizontal lockup ≤ 240px wide, 1× and 2× |

---

## 8. Asset checklist

- [ ] Every asset has a source file (SVG/Figma) next to the export.
- [ ] Names follow the convention; no spaces or dates.
- [ ] SVG optimised and recolourable; PNG at 2×.
- [ ] Screenshots redacted and re-shot on the token theme.
- [ ] `client/public/` contains only build inputs actually referenced by `index.html`,
      the manifest or the components (delete `public/public/`, `demo_icon.png`,
      `assets/logo.svg` once replaced).
- [ ] `design/04-assets/CHANGELOG.md` updated with what changed and why.

# Design Operations & Adoption Roadmap

How this documentation stays true, who changes it, and in which order the work lands.

---

## 1. Ownership

| Area | Owner | Decides |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brand platform, logo, voice | Whoever owns marketing/brand | Naming, logo usage, tone, external assets |
| Colour, typography, foundations | Design lead (`Designer` profile) | Tokens, scales, component anatomy |
| Implementation | Frontend | How tokens become CSS/Vue; may veto on cost, not on intent |
| Accessibility | Whoever signs the release | Conformance statement, blocking regressions |
| This folder | Design lead | Merges to `design/` |

One owner per area. A change to brand values requires brand-owner approval **in the PR
description**, not in a chat.

---

## 2. Versioning

`design/` version follows the product's **design** version, not the app version:

| Version | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0.x` | Proposal stage — tokens may change without migration |
| `1.0` | Tokens implemented in code, two themes live, logo exists |
| `1.x` | Additive: new components, new docs. No breaking token renames |
| `2.0` | Breaking: a token is renamed/removed, a theme is dropped |

Every breaking change needs a migration note in this file's changelog section and a
grep-able list of the call sites.

### Changelog

| Date | Version | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| — | 0.1 | Initial audit + brand platform, colour, typography, foundations, core components, IA, accessibility, assets |

---

## 3. Change process

```
idea → issue (in this project's board, column "Design")
     → draft in a branch touching design/** only
     → review by: design lead (intent) + frontend (feasibility) + a11y (contrast/focus)
     → merge → if it changes values, update tokens/design-tokens.json and regenerate CSS
```

Rules:

1. **Docs before code.** A new colour, radius, spacing step or component pattern is
   added here first. Code that introduces an undocumented value is a review reject.
2. **Tokens are the contract.** If `design-tokens.json` and a component disagree, the
   token wins and the component is the bug.
3. **No silent brand changes.** Recolouring a logo, renaming a product surface or
   dropping a theme is a `2.0` event.
4. **Evidence beats opinion** in reviews: a contrast number, a screenshot at 390px, a
   keyboard walkthrough.

---

## 4. Review checklist (paste into any PR touching UI)

```
[ ] Uses tokens (no raw hex, no arbitrary px, no new radius)
[ ] Both themes checked (dark + light)
[ ] Checked at 390 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 / 1920 px
[ ] isMobile true AND false paths checked (≤1024px uses the mobile shell)
[ ] All six states: default / hover / focus-visible / active / disabled / loading
[ ] Keyboard: reachable, operable, focus visible, Escape closes overlays
[ ] Contrast verified for text, control borders, icons, focus ring
[ ] Colour is never the only meaning carrier
[ ] Touch targets ≥ 44px on mobile
[ ] Copy follows voice-and-tone.md (sentence case, units, error formula)
[ ] Empty / filtered-empty / loading / error / permission / offline states designed
[ ] Icon: one set, aria-hidden when decorative, aria-label when icon-only
[ ] New portal surface uses the z-ladder (foundations.md §6)
```

---

## 5. Adoption roadmap

Sequenced so each phase removes a class of future inconsistency. Effort: S ≤ 2 days,
M ≤ 1 week, L > 1 week (one frontend).

### Phase 0 — Stop the drift (≈3 days)
| Task | Effort | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Delete `daisy-override.css`, `assets/themes/*.css`, `assets/logo.svg` | S | Dead/incorrect brand code (audit §2, §8) |

# Design Foundations

Space, radius, elevation, motion, icons, layering and layout grids.
These are the primitives every component composes; they are the part that must not
drift.

**Implementation target:** Tailwind v4 `@theme` variables generated from
`design/tokens/design-tokens.json`. Until then, values below are the reference and the
current implementation is noted for comparison.

---

## 1. Spacing — 4px base, 8px rhythm

Tailwind's scale is already 4px-based (`1 = 0.25rem`). Use it; do not invent pixels.

| Token | px | rem | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space.0-5` | 2 | 0.125 | Optical nudges only |
| `space.1` | 4 | 0.25 | Icon ↔ label |
| `space.1-5` | 6 | 0.375 | Inside badges/chips |
| `space.2` | 8 | 0.5 | Inside buttons, tight stacks |
| `space.3` | 12 | 0.75 | List row padding, control gaps |
| `space.4` | 16 | 1 | Card padding, form field gap |
| `space.5` | 20 | 1.25 | Section inner padding |
| `space.6` | 24 | 1.5 | Panel padding, region gap |
| `space.8` | 32 | 2 | Between major sections |
| `space.12` | 48 | 3 | Page-level breathing |

**Rhythm rule:** vertical spacing between siblings comes from `2 / 3 / 4`;
spacing *between regions* from `6 / 8`. Mixing the two is what makes dense UIs feel
simultaneously cramped and scattered.

Density: this product is **compact by default** (`13–14px` text, `12px` row padding).
A "comfortable" density is not offered — it would break the tables users rely on.

---

## 2. Radius

| Token | Value | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius.field` | `0.375rem` (6px) | Inputs, selects, small buttons, checkboxes |
| `radius.box` | `0.5rem` (8px) | Cards, panels, dropdowns, toasts |
| `radius.selector` | `0.75rem` (12px) | Tabs, segmented controls, nav items, mobile icon buttons |
| `radius.modal` | `0.75rem` (12px) | Dialogs |
| `radius.full` | `9999px` | Pills, avatars, status dots, tags |

The daisyUI theme already declares `--radius-selector: 0.75rem`, `--radius-field:
0.375rem`, `--radius-box: 0.5rem` — **keep these three names**, they are the contract.
One inconsistency to fix: `Modal.vue` uses `rounded-lg` (8px) while the mobile icon
buttons use `rounded-xl` (12px); dialogs should be `radius.modal` (12px).

**Never mix radii inside one component.** A card with a 12px body, an 8px header and a
9999px button reads as three objects.

---

## 3. Elevation

Dark UIs cannot rely on shadows; elevation is communicated by **surface lightness +
border + blur**.

| Level | Dark | Light | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 flat | `surface.base` | `#FFF` | Canvas, panels |
| 1 raised | `surface.raised` + `border.subtle` | `#FFF` + `border.default` | Cards, sidebar sections |
| 2 overlay | `surface.overlay` + `border.default` + `shadow-lg` | `#FFF` + `shadow-lg` | Dropdowns, popovers, toasts |
| 3 modal | `surface.overlay` + `border.default` + `shadow-2xl` + backdrop `blur-sm` | same | Dialogs |

Rules: no shadow on flat surfaces; no `shadow-xl` on inline elements; the backdrop of a
modal is `bg-base-100/60 backdrop-blur-sm` (already the pattern in `Modal.vue` — keep it).

---

## 4. Motion

| Token | Duration | Easing | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `motion.instant` | 0ms | — | State that must feel native (press, toggle) |
| `motion.fast` | 150ms | `ease` | Hover, focus, colour, opacity |
| `motion.base` | 200ms | `ease` | Sidebar width, tab change, menu open |
| `motion.slow` | 300ms | `ease` | Modal enter, panel expand |
| `motion.sheet` | 240ms | `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` | Mobile sheets (already in `base.css`) |

Rules:

1. **Only animate `transform` and `opacity`.** Never animate `width`/`height` on a
   surface that scrolls or contains a virtualised list (the sidebar's `w-16 ⇄ w-64`
   transition is 200ms of layout thrash on every toggle — acceptable today, but do not
   copy it into new surfaces; use `transform: translateX` + a fixed-width container).

```md design/01-brand/voice-and-tone.md
# Voice & Tone

How codx-junior speaks. Applies to every string in the product, the docs, the error
messages and the marketing site.

---

## 1. Voice (constant)

**An experienced teammate who happens to be a machine.**

- **Direct.** State the fact, then the action. "Build failed. 2 tests, `auth.spec.ts`."
- **Specific.** Names, numbers, paths, durations. Never "something went wrong".
- **Calm.** No exclamation marks. No "Oops!". No emojis in errors.
- **Honest about uncertainty.** "I couldn't reach the container" beats "An unexpected
  error occurred".
- **Second person, active.** "You can retry" / "codx-junior is running the tests".

**Not:** a mascot, a hype-man, a helpdesk script, a lawyer.

---

## 2. Tone by context

| Context | Tone | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Empty state | Inviting, one action | **No chats yet.** Start one and codx-junior will pick up your project context. `[New chat]` |
| Working / streaming | Terse status, present continuous | `Running tests… 3 of 12` · `Reading api/chat/chat_engine.py` |
| Success | One word, or one line + detail | `Merged` · `PR #128 merged into main. 4 files changed.` |
| Warning (budget, limits) | Factual + the threshold | `Daily budget at 82%. Runs will pause at 100%.` |
| Error (recoverable) | What happened + what to do | **Couldn't reach the API.** Check the container is running, then retry. `[Retry]` `[View logs]` |
| Error (user-caused) | Neutral, no blame, no humour | `Name is required.` not `You forgot the name!` |
| Destructive confirm | Consequence first, verb last | **Delete board "Sprint 12"?** 14 tasks will be removed. This can't be undone. `[Cancel]` `[Delete board]` |
| Handover to human | Explicit, no ambiguity | `Waiting for you — login required.` `[Take over]` |
| AI-generated prose | Neutral, no self-reference | "The endpoint returns 404 when the project is archived." (not "I think that…") |

---

## 3. Micro-rules

| Rule | Do | Don't |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sentence case everywhere | `Save changes` | `Save Changes` |
| Verbs on buttons, noun elsewhere | `Delete board` / `Board deleted` | `Deletion` |
| Second person for humans, third for the agent | `You paused the run` / `codx-junior paused the run` | `We paused` |
| Numbers as digits | `3 files`, `2m 12s` | `three files` |
| Units always | `12.4k tokens`, `$0.42`, `1.2 GB` | `12.4k`, `0.42` |
| Ellipsis for in-progress, not for menus | `Deleting…` | `Settings…` |
| No trailing period on labels/buttons | `Run tests` | `Run tests.` |
| Period at the end of sentences in body/errors | `Retry to continue.` | `Retry to continue` |
| Max ~90 characters per toast | `Saved` / `Copied to clipboard` | A paragraph |

---

## 4. Vocabulary (use these words, not those)

| Use | Instead of | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **chat** | conversation, thread, session | The product term |
| **task** | ticket, issue, card (except visually) | A task is the unit of work |
| **board** / **column** / **card** | kanban, lane | Familiar to the user |
| **run** | job, execution, orchestration | `harness run` |
| **step** | subtask, phase, stage | One unit of a run |
| **profile** | persona, agent role, bot | A profile has instructions and tools |
| **team** | group, org | Teams contain humans *and* profiles |
| **workspace** | environment, sandbox, container app | A workspace *runs in* a container |
| **project** | repo, workspace | A project may have several repos |
| **knowledge** | RAG, embeddings, vectors | Never expose the implementation |
| **take over** | intervene, hijack, assume control | The human/AI handover |
| **budget** / **cxjcoins** | credits, quota, tokens | `cxjcoins` is the currency name |
| **AI** (as adjective) | artificial intelligence, LLM (in UI) | `AI models`, not `LLM models` in chrome |

Identifiers stay machine-formatted in machine contexts: `software_developer`,
`claude-sonnet-4-5`, `codx-junior-harness`.

--

# Information Architecture & Core Flows

Derived from the two registries that actually drive navigation:
`client/src/config/apps.js` (29 app keys) and `client/src/config/mobile.js`
(4 tabs + 5 launcher groups).

---

## 1. The navigation model (as built)

codx-junior does **not** have pages. It has **apps** that can be opened in two ways:

```
                 ┌──────────────────────────┐
   user action →│  openApp(key, payload)    │
                 └───────────┬──────────────┘
                             │ reads config/apps.js
              ┌──────────────┴───────────────┐
   !isMobile / desktop            isMobile / single
              │                              │
   dockview PANEL (expert)        ROUTE (router)
   multi-instance by params       params in the URL
```

Consequences that must be respected by every design:

- **The same app must look right in both destinations.** A screen designed only as a
  dockview panel will be wrong as a full-page route (no sidebar, its own scroll,
  back button, 60px tab bar).
- **Multi-instance apps open several panels** (`tasks` per board, `browser-viewer` per
  session, `file-viewer` per file, `workspace` per workspace, `team-channel` per
  channel). Their titles must be distinguishable — include the instance name.
- **Deep links are real.** Boards, chats, teams and workspaces encode their identity in
  the URL; a design that hides "where am I" breaks refresh and sharing.

---

## 2. The app catalogue (grouped the way users think)

### Work
| App | Key | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Home | `home` | Command centre; mobile uses the management dashboard as home |
| Chats | (route `chats`) | Inbox of conversations |
| New chat | — | Primary action, available from every shell |
| Task Manager | `tasks` | Multi-instance (one panel per board) |
| Planning | `planning` | Same component as Task Manager, `view: planning` |
| Company | `company` | Org, hybrid teams, missions, autopilot |
| Management | `management-dashboard` | Cross-project pulse, blockers, delivery, cost |
| Projects | `projects` | Browse every project |
| Harness | `harness` | Runs, worker health, audit journal |

### People
Messenger (`messenger`) · Meet (`meet`) · Team (`team`, plus `team-channel`)

### Build
Files (`file-explorer` / `file-viewer`) · Git (`git-view`) · Workspaces
(`workspaces` / `workspace`) · Browsers (`browser-sessions` / `browser-viewer`) ·
Infrastructure (`infra`) · Wiki (`wiki`) · Docs (`docs`) · Knowledge (`knowledge`)

### Insights
Analytics (`analytics`) · Metrics (`metrics`) · API monitoring (`api-monitoring`) ·
Chat logs (`chat-logs`) · Decision logs (`decision-model-logs`) · Logs (`log-viewer`)

### Account
Project settings (`settings`) · Global settings (`global-settings`) ·
Knowledge settings (`knowledge_settings`, `wiki_settings`) · Account (`account`) ·
Vibe coding (`vibe-coding`) · Solopreneur (`solopreneur`)

---

## 3. Shells

| Shell | Who | Chrome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Desktop** | `!isMobile` | 64/256px sidebar (apps + workspaces + user footer) · dockview workspace · status/toast |
| **Mobile** | `≤1024px` | 56px top bar (title, back, actions) · content · 60px tab bar (Home, Chats, Tasks, More) |
| **Company** | company role | Own tab bar (Company, Ask, Add person, New team, More) — desktop keeps the standard shell |

.dt td { height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; }
.dt tr.sel td { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); }
.dt .num { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

/* chat */
.chatrow { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.avatar { flex: 0 0 32px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.avatar.ai { background: var(--brand-600); color: #fff; }
.avatar.me { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--info) 25%, transparent); color: var(--info); }
.bubble { max-width: 620px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-box); font-size: 16px; line-height: 26px; }
.bubble.ai { background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 30%, transparent); }
.bubble.me { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 20%, transparent); }
.meta { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-3); margin-top: 6px; }
.cursor { display: inline-block; width: 2px; height: 18px; background: var(--primary); vertical-align: -3px; animation: blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

/* banner */
.handover {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 14%, transparent);
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 30%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 30%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-box);
}
.handover .ic { color: var(--warning); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; }
.handover b { font-size: 14px; }
.handover p { margin: 2px 0 8px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-2); }

/* board card */
.kcard { position: relative; background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-field); padding: 10px 12px 10px 14px; }
.kcard::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px; background: var(--info); }
.kcard.hi::before { background: var(--error); }
.kcard .ttl { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
.kcard .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-3); }
.avstack { display: flex; }
.avstack .avatar { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 20px; font-size: 9px; border: 2px solid var(--raised); }
.avstack .avatar + .avatar { margin-left: -6px; }

/* modal specimen */
.frame { position: relative; height: 300px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-box); overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg); }
.frame .page-mock { padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.frame .bar-mock { height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--fg) 8%, transparent); }
.modal-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; place-items: center; padding: 16px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 60%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.modal-layer.open { display: grid; }
.modal-box { width: 100%; max-width: 380px; background: var(--overlay); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-selector); box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal); overflow: hidden; }
.modal-box header { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
.modal-box header .x { margin-left: auto; }
.modal-box .body { padding: 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-2); }
.modal-box footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }

/* toast */
.toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 320px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-box); box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay); font-size: 14px; }
.toast.success { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 20%, var(--raised)); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 35%, transparent); }
.toast.error { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--error) 20%, var(--raised)); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--error) 35%, transparent); }
.toast .x { margin-left: auto; color: var(--fg-3); cursor: pointer; }

/* empty */
.empty { text-align: center; padding: 32px 16px; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto; }
.empty .ic { font-size: 24px; color: var(--fg-4); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.empty h4 { font-size: 16px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
.empty p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-2); margin: 0 0 12px; }

/* spacing / radius / elevation / z */
.bars { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 66px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-3); }
.bar-row .b { height: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; }
.rgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.rbox { background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg-3); }
.egrid { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.elayer { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-box); font-size: 12px; }
.e0 { background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.e1 { background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.e2 { background: var(--overlay); border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay); }
.e3 { background: var(--overlay); border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal); }
.zrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 44px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.zrow .t { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--fg-3); }
.zrow .v { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--primary-fg); text-align: right; }
.zbar { height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 45%, transparent); }

/* layout diagrams */
.layout { display: flex; gap: 6px; height: 168px; }
.layout .box { border-radius: var(--radius-field); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg-3); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--raised); text-align: center; padding: 4px; }
.layout .rail { flex: 0 0 64px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, var(--raised)); }
.layout .col { flex: 1; }
.phone { width: 190px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 40px 1fr 44px; height: 300px; }
.phone .top { display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg-3); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--raised); }
.phone .mid { background: var(--bg); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg-4); }
.phone .bot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--raised); }
.phone .bot span { display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--fg-3); }
.phone .bot span.on { color: var(--primary-fg); }

/* a11y list */
.a11y { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.a11y .item { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-field); background: var(--raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-size: 13px; }
.a11y .item .st { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 11px; }
.kbd { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--fg) 10%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--fg); }

/* footer */
footer { margin-top: 64px; padding: 24px 0 60px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-3); }
footer .links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

/* ── 14. Responsive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .toc { position: static; max-height: none; overflow: visible; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 12px 16px; }
  .toc .label, .toc .grp { display: none; }

}

}

}

      from the shipped product (<code>client/</code>) and from the decisions in
      <code>design/</code>. The specimens on this page are rendered with the real

  <!-- ══ 10 rules ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="rules">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">01</span><h2>The 10 rules</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">If you remember nothing else, remember these. They are the decisions that
      prevented 90% of the inconsistency found in the audit.</p>
    <div class="rules">
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">1</span><div><b>Two themes, one brand</b><span>Dark is default, light is supported. Never add a third palette or a "temporary" accent.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">2</span><div><b>Magenta text on dark is pink</b><span><code>#CC0099</code> is a fill (white text, 4.8:1). As <em>text</em> on dark use <code>#FF69B4</code> (5.5:1).</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">3</span><div><b>Tokens only</b><span>No raw hex, no arbitrary px, no new radius outside <code>tokens.css</code>.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">4</span><div><b>Magenta ≤ 10% of pixels</b><span>An accent is an accent. A screen that is mostly magenta has lost its hierarchy.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">5</span><div><b>Two voices only</b><span>Interface sans, and mono for anything you could paste into a terminal. No third family.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">6</span><div><b>Compact by default</b><span>13–14px text, 12px row padding, 36px rows. There is no "comfortable" mode.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">7</span><div><b>Elevation = surface + border</b><span>Shadows only for overlay and modal. Never a shadow on a flat surface.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">8</span><div><b>Six states, always</b><span>default · hover · focus-visible · active · disabled · loading. All six, every component.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">9</span><div><b>Colour is never the only meaning</b><span>Every status colour is paired with a word or an icon.</span></div></div>
      <div class="rule"><span class="n">10</span><div><b>Panel and route, both</b><span>Same app renders in dockview (desktop) and as a full route (mobile). Check <code>isMobile</code> true and false.</span></div></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══ Brand ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="brand">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">02</span><h2>What codx-junior is</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">The product is an AI teammate that runs inside your project — chats, runs,
      boards, workspaces, browsers — on one screen, with you watching. The design has to make
      a machine's work legible and reversible.</p>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Positioning</div>
        <p style="margin:0; font-size:16px; line-height:26px;">
          <strong>codx-junior turns a project into a place where work happens.</strong>
          Not a chat window bolted onto an IDE, not a dashboard about work — the
          workbench itself.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Who it is for</div>
        <ul style="margin:0; color:var(--fg-2); font-size:13px;">
          <li><strong>The solo builder</strong> who wants a team, not a tool.</li>
          <li><strong>The tech lead</strong> who must see what the AI did and why.</li>
          <li><strong>The team</strong> mixing humans and profiles behind one board.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin-bottom:10px;">Five personality traits</h3>
    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th style="width:130px;">Trait</th><th>It means</th><th>In the UI</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Composed</td><td>Never shouts, never panics</td><td>No exclamation marks, no red decoration, calm empty states</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Precise</td><td>Numbers and names, not adjectives</td><td>Paths, durations, token counts, model ids — always with units</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Transparent</td><td>The work is visible while it runs</td><td>Persistent step trace, cost accrues in place, diffs inline</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Reversible</td><td>Everything can be undone or taken over</td><td>Cancel, retry, branch, restore; handover banner for humans</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Warm, not cute</td><td>Personality lives in copy, not mascots</td><td>No illustrations in-product, no emoji icons, one human moment on the landing page</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">"Running tests… 3 of 12" · "Merged" · "Couldn't reach the API. Check the container, then retry."</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">"Oops! Something went wrong 😢" · "Successfully saved!" · "Unexpected error occurred."</div></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══ Logo ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

    <h3 style="margin:24px 0 8px;">Four mandatory colour variants</h3>
    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
      <div class="demo" style="background:#1F2937; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);">
        <div class="demo-label" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);">Primary / dark</div>
        <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true"><g stroke="url(#gA)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="13" y1="13" x2="51" y2="51"/><line x1="51" y1="13" x2="13" y2="51"/></g><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="5.5" fill="#FF69B4"/></svg>
        <div style="color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; margin-top:6px;">codx<span style="color:#FF69B4">-</span>junior</div>
      </div>
      <div class="demo" style="background:#fff; border-color:#E2E2EA;">

  <section id="colour">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">04</span><h2>Colour</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">One brand hue, one neutral ramp with a blue-slate bias (so magenta does not
      vibrate), four semantics. Click any swatch to copy its hex.</p>

    <h3 style="margin-bottom:8px;">Magenta — the signature</h3>
    <div class="ramp" role="list">
      <button class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FFF0FA" data-copy="#FFF0FA" role="listitem"><span class="step">50</span><span>#FFF0FA</span></button>
      <button class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FFD6F0" data-copy="#FFD6F0" role="listitem"><span class="step">100</span><span>#FFD6F0</span></button>
      <button class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FFAEE0" data-copy="#FFAEE0" role="listitem"><span class="step">200</span><span>#FFAEE0</span></button>
      <button class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FF80CE" data-copy="#FF80CE" role="listitem"><span class="step">300</span><span>#FF80CE</span></button>
      <button class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FF69B4" data-copy="#FF69B4" role="listitem"><span class="step">400</span><span>#FF69B4</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#F530A8" data-copy="#F530A8" role="listitem"><span class="step">500</span><span>#F530A8</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#CC0099" data-copy="#CC0099" role="listitem"><span class="step">600</span><span>#CC0099</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#A3007A" data-copy="#A3007A" role="listitem"><span class="step">700</span><span>#A3007A</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#7A005B" data-copy="#7A005B" role="listitem"><span class="step">800</span><span>#7A005B</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#4D0039" data-copy="#4D0039" role="listitem"><span class="step">900</span><span>#4D0039</span></button>
    </div>
    <p class="ramp-note"><strong>600 = #CC0099 is <em>the</em> brand colour.</strong> 400 (#FF69B4) is the
      dark-mode text colour. 900 is the tinted dark background. Retired: <code>#CC049C</code> (a 3/255
      near-miss from dead CSS) and <code>#6366F1</code> indigo (old Designer profile).</p>

    <h3 style="margin-bottom:8px;">Purple — secondary, depth only</h3>
    <div class="ramp p2" role="list">
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#C24AC2" data-copy="#C24AC2"><span class="step">400</span><span>#C24AC2</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#B000B0" data-copy="#B000B0"><span class="step">500</span><span>#B000B0</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#8F008F" data-copy="#8F008F"><span class="step">600</span><span>#8F008F</span></button>
      <button class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#6B006B" data-copy="#6B006B"><span class="step">700</span><span>#6B006B</span></button>
    </div>
    <p class="ramp-note"><strong>#8F008F on the dark canvas is 1.8:1.</strong> Gradient stops and chart series only — never text on dark.</p>

    <h3 style="margin:24px 0 8px;">Neutrals & surfaces</h3>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Dark (default)</div>
        <div class="ramp p2" style="margin:0;">
          <div class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#1F2937" data-copy="#1F2937"><span class="step">base</span><span>#1F2937</span></div>
          <div class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#273244" data-copy="#273244"><span class="step">raised</span><span>#273244</span></div>
          <div class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#2F3A4D" data-copy="#2F3A4D"><span class="step">overlay</span><span>#2F3A4D</span></div>
          <div class="swatch light-txt" style="background:#161E29" data-copy="#161E29"><span class="step">sunken</span><span>#161E29</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Light (supported)</div>
        <div class="ramp p2" style="margin:0;">
          <div class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FFFFFF" data-copy="#FFFFFF"><span class="step">base</span><span>#FFFFFF</span></div>
          <div class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#FAFAFC" data-copy="#FAFAFC"><span class="step">raised</span><span>#FAFAFC</span></div>
          <div class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#F0F0F5" data-copy="#F0F0F5"><span class="step">overlay</span><span>#F0F0F5</span></div>
          <div class="swatch dark-txt" style="background:#F3F4F6" data-copy="#F3F4F6"><span class="step">sunken</span><span>#F3F4F6</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="ramp-note" style="margin-top:8px;">
      <strong>Opacity rule:</strong> hierarchy is built from <em>opacity of base-content</em>
      (70% secondary, 55% tertiary, 40% disabled) — never from a new grey. That is what keeps
      400+ components consistent across both themes.
    </p>

    <h3 style="margin:24px 0 8px;">Semantic — same hue, different lightness</h3>
    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
      <div class="card"><span class="badge info">info</span><div class="mono" style="font-size:11px; color:var(--fg-3); margin-top:8px;">dark oklch(75% .22 220)<br>light #4696DC</div><p style="margin:6px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Neutral information, links.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><span class="badge success">success</span><div class="mono" style="font-size:11px; color:var(--fg-3); margin-top:8px;">dark oklch(68% .28 140)<br>light #3CB450</div><p style="margin:6px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Saved, passed, merged, connected.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><span class="badge warning">warning</span><div class="mono" style="font-size:11px; color:var(--fg-3); margin-top:8px;">dark oklch(82% .26 70)<br>light #FFB428</div><p style="margin:6px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Budget, retry, degraded, review.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><span class="badge error">error</span><div class="mono" style="font-size:11px; color:var(--fg-3); margin-top:8px;">dark oklch(68% .32 25)<br>light #F05050</div><p style="margin:6px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Failed, destructive, blocked.</p></div>
    </div>
    <p class="ramp-note">Magenta never means "error". Magenta means <em>codx-junior</em>.</p>

    <h3 style="margin:24px 0 8px;">Contrast — the numbers that constrain the design</h3>
    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Foreground</th><th>on #1F2937 (dark)</th><th>on #FFFFFF (light)</th><th>Verdict</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>#CC0099 brand</td><td><span class="chip err">3.1 : 1 ✕</span></td><td><span class="chip ok">4.8 : 1 ✓</span></td><td>Fill on dark, text on light</td></tr>
          <tr><td>#FF69B4 pink</td><td><span class="chip ok">5.5 : 1 ✓</span></td><td><span class="chip err">2.0 : 1 ✕</span></td><td>Text on dark only</td></tr>
          <tr><td>#8F008F purple</td><td><span class="chip err">1.8 : 1 ✕</span></td><td><span class="chip ok">8.2 : 1 ✓</span></td><td>Gradient / fill on dark</td></tr>
          <tr><td>#FFFFFF on #CC0099</td><td><span class="chip ok">4.8 : 1 ✓</span></td><td>—</td><td>Primary buttons pass</td></tr>
          <tr><td>#FFFFFF on #FF69B4</td><td><span class="chip err">2.0 : 1 ✕</span></td><td>—</td><td>Pink fills need dark text</td></tr>
          <tr><td>#111827 on #FF69B4</td><td><span class="chip ok">10.4 : 1 ✓</span></td><td>—</td><td>Ink on pink passes</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="demo">
        <div class="demo-label">The 10% rule — correct</div>

  <section id="type">

    <p class="sub">Two voices. The interface speaks in a neutral system sans, the machine speaks in
      monospace. <strong>Test:</strong> if a user could paste the string into a terminal and it would mean
      something, it is monospace. That single rule makes the product read technical and calm.</p>

  <!-- ══ Voice ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="voice">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">06</span><h2>Voice & tone</h2></div>
    <p class="sub"><strong>An experienced teammate who happens to be a machine.</strong> Direct, specific,
      calm, honest about uncertainty, second person and active. Not a mascot, not a hype-man,
      not a helpdesk script.</p>

    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th style="width:150px;">Context</th><th style="width:180px;">Tone</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Empty state</td><td>Inviting, one action</td><td><strong>No chats yet.</strong> Start one and codx-junior will pick up your project context. <code>[New chat]</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Working</td><td>Terse, present continuous</td><td><code>Running tests… 3 of 12</code> · <code>Reading api/chat/chat_engine.py</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Success</td><td>One word, or one line + detail</td><td><code>Merged</code> · <code>PR #128 merged into main. 4 files changed.</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Warning</td><td>Factual + the threshold</td><td><code>Daily budget at 82%. Runs will pause at 100%.</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Error (recoverable)</td><td>What happened + what to do</td><td><strong>Couldn't reach the API.</strong> Check the container is running, then retry. <code>[Retry]</code> <code>[View logs]</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Destructive confirm</td><td>Consequence first, verb last</td><td><strong>Delete board "Sprint 12"?</strong> 14 tasks will be removed. This can't be undone. <code>[Cancel]</code> <code>[Delete board]</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Handover to human</td><td>Explicit, no ambiguity</td><td><code>Waiting for you — login required.</code> <code>[Take over]</code></td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Error formula</div>
        <div class="codeblock" style="margin:0;"><pre><code>[What failed]. [Why, if known]. [What to do next].</code></pre></div>
        <ul style="margin:12px 0 0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">
          <li>Couldn't start the container. Port 8080 is already in use. Stop the other service or change the port.</li>
          <li>Git push rejected. The remote has 3 commits you don't have. Pull first, then push again.</li>
          <li>Request timed out after 120s. The model may be overloaded. Retry, or switch to a smaller model.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Use these words</div>
        <table style="margin:0; font-size:12px;">
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>chat</td><td>not conversation / thread / session</td></tr>
            <tr><td>task · board · column · card</td><td>not ticket / issue / lane</td></tr>
            <tr><td>run · step</td><td>not job / execution / phase</td></tr>
            <tr><td>profile · team</td><td>not persona / agent role / bot</td></tr>
            <tr><td>workspace</td><td>not sandbox / environment</td></tr>
            <tr><td>take over</td><td>not intervene / hijack</td></tr>
            <tr><td>budget · cxjcoins</td><td>not credits / quota / tokens</td></tr>
            <tr><td>knowledge</td><td>never RAG / embeddings in UI</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g3">

  <section id="foundations">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">07</span><h2>Foundations</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">The primitives every component composes. This is the part that must not drift.</p>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Spacing — 4px base, 8px rhythm</div>
        <div class="bars">
          <div class="bar-row"><span>0.5 · 2px</span><div class="b" style="width:2px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>1 · 4px</span><div class="b" style="width:4px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>1.5 · 6px</span><div class="b" style="width:6px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>2 · 8px</span><div class="b" style="width:8px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>3 · 12px</span><div class="b" style="width:12px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>4 · 16px</span><div class="b" style="width:16px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>5 · 20px</span><div class="b" style="width:20px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>6 · 24px</span><div class="b" style="width:24px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>8 · 32px</span><div class="b" style="width:32px"></div></div>
          <div class="bar-row"><span>12 · 48px</span><div class="b" style="width:48px"></div></div>
        </div>
        <p style="margin:12px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">
          <strong>Rhythm:</strong> between siblings <code>2 / 3 / 4</code>; between regions <code>6 / 8</code>.
          Mixing the two is what makes dense UIs feel cramped <em>and</em> scattered.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Radius — three names are the contract</div>
        <div class="rgrid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);">
          <div class="rbox" style="border-radius:var(--radius-field);">field · 6px</div>
          <div class="rbox" style="border-radius:var(--radius-box);">box · 8px</div>
          <div class="rbox" style="border-radius:var(--radius-selector);">selector · 12px</div>
        </div>
        <p style="margin:12px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">
          Inputs · cards, panels, dropdowns, toasts · tabs, nav items, <strong>dialogs</strong>.
          <code>radius.full</code> for pills, avatars, dots. <strong>Never mix radii inside one component.</strong>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:12px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Elevation — surface + border, not shadow</div>
        <div class="egrid">
          <div class="elayer e0">0 · flat — canvas / panel</div>
          <div class="elayer e1">1 · raised — card + border.subtle</div>
          <div class="elayer e2">2 · overlay — dropdown, toast + shadow-lg</div>
          <div class="elayer e3">3 · modal — dialog + shadow-2xl + backdrop blur</div>
        </div>
        <p style="margin:12px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Dark UIs cannot rely on shadows. No shadow on a flat surface, ever.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Motion</div>
        <table style="margin:0;">
          <tbody>
            <tr><td><code>instant</code></td><td>0ms — press, toggle</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code>fast</code></td><td>150ms ease — hover, focus, colour</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code>base</code></td><td>200ms ease — sidebar, tab change</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code>slow</code></td><td>300ms ease — modal enter</td></tr>

          </tbody>
        </table>
        <p style="margin:12px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">
          Animate <code>transform</code> and <code>opacity</code> only · never loop except an in-progress indicator ·
          respect <code>prefers-reduced-motion</code> · no entrance animation on streamed content.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

  <section id="patterns">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">09</span><h2>Patterns & states</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">The states that are usually forgotten. Every list, board, table, panel and route
      needs all of them designed.</p>

    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>State</th><th>What to design</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Loading</td><td>Skeleton with the real layout (5 rows, real column widths). Never a full-page spinner for a section refresh. < 300ms: show nothing.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Empty (first use)</td><td>One sentence of what this is + one primary action. No illustration.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Empty (filtered)</td><td>"No results for <code>auth</code>" + <code>Clear filters</code>. Never the first-use text.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Error</td><td>Inline block with retry; the panel stays open. Full-page error only when the route cannot render.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Streaming / running</td><td>Persistent step trace + elapsed + cancel. Composer never scrolls away.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Permission denied</td><td>Explanation + the action that requests access.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Offline / disconnected</td><td>Sidebar footer shows <code>offline</code>; banner when actions are blocked.</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

  <!-- ══ IA ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="ia">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">10</span><h2>Information architecture</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">codx-junior does not have pages. It has <strong>apps</strong> that open in two ways:
      a dockview <em>panel</em> on desktop, a router <em>route</em> on mobile. Design for both, always.</p>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; line-height:22px; overflow-x:auto;">
      <div style="color:var(--fg-4);">// the only navigation primitive</div>
      <div>user action → <span style="color:var(--primary-fg)">openApp(key, payload)</span> <span style="color:var(--fg-4)">// reads config/apps.js</span></div>
      <div>  ├─ !isMobile → <strong>dockview PANEL</strong> <span style="color:var(--fg-4)">(multi-instance by params)</span></div>
      <div>  └─  isMobile → <strong>ROUTE</strong> <span style="color:var(--fg-4)">(params in the URL)</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-bottom:12px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Four shells</div>
        <table style="margin:0;">
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>Desktop</td><td>64/256px rail + dockview + status/toast</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Mobile ≤1024px</td><td>56px top bar + content + 60px tab bar</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Company</td><td>Own tab bar: Company · Ask · Add person · New team · More</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Solopreneur</td><td>Full-screen route, no codx-junior chrome</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Naming conventions</div>
        <table style="margin:0;">
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>App titles</td><td>Title Case · <code>Task Manager</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>Panel titles</td><td>Instance-qualified · <code>Tasks — Sprint 12</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>Routes</td><td>kebab-case · <code>/git-view</code></td></tr>
            <tr><td>Profiles</td><td><code>snake_case</code> id, Title Case in prose</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Machine values</td><td>mono, unchanged</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin:20px 0 8px;">The app catalogue — grouped the way users think</h3>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Work</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">Home · Chats · New chat · Task Manager · Planning · Company · Management · Projects · Harness</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">People</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">Messenger · Meet · Team · Team channel</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Build</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">Files · File viewer · Git · Workspaces · Browsers · Infrastructure · Wiki · Docs · Knowledge</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Insights</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">Analytics · Metrics · API monitoring · Chat logs · Decision logs · Logs</p></div>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin:20px 0 8px;">The five flows that matter</h3>
    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th style="width:190px;">Flow</th><th>Design requirement</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td><strong>F1</strong> Ask, watch it happen</td><td>Step trace always visible while running; cost and time accrue in place; composer never scrolls away; a finished run collapses to a summary.</td></tr>
          <tr><td><strong>F2</strong> Track the work</td><td>Card = task + conversation + artifacts. Dragging must not lose scroll or selection. Board, Planning, Sprint and Table are views of the same tasks.</td></tr>
          <tr><td><strong>F3</strong> Review a change</td><td>Diff typography is non-negotiable (mono, fixed line-height, tab-size 2). Three panes on desktop, three routes on mobile. Risk summary on top.</td></tr>
          <tr><td><strong>F4</strong> Hand over to a machine session</td><td>The live view is the hero; the control lease (who is driving) is always visible; the handover banner is the only switch.</td></tr>
          <tr><td><strong>F5</strong> Understand cost & health</td><td>One time-window control reused everywhere; every number has a unit and a comparison; partial-data states designed.</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="border-left:3px solid var(--warning);">
      <div class="demo-label">Design debt</div>
      <p style="margin:0; font-size:13px; color:var(--fg-2);">Desktop hides apps behind <code>WindowsMenu</code>, mobile behind
        <em>More</em> — two mental models for one catalogue. Target: <strong>one "Everything" launcher</strong> for both shells,
        same grouping and search (the mobile <code>MOBILE_APP_GROUPS</code> already models it — promote it).</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══ A11y ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="a11y">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">11</span><h2>Accessibility</h2><span class="chip">WCAG 2.2 AA</span></div>
    <p class="sub">Not a phase — a release condition. Contrast, keyboard and focus are the three that
      regress silently, so they are the three that get checked every time.</p>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Current status</div>
        <div class="a11y">
          <div class="item"><span class="chip err">✕</span><span>Magenta text on dark canvas — 3.1:1 (needs 4.5)</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip err">✕</span><span>Modal at <code>z-50</code> paints under the mobile nav</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip err">✕</span><span>No focus trap in <code>Modal.vue</code>; focus not restored</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip warn">△</span><span>Collapsed rail relies on <code>title</code>, not real tooltips</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip warn">△</span><span>Headings styled by size, not by document outline</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip ok">✓</span><span>Decorative icons carry <code>aria-hidden</code> (MobileTabBar)</span></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="chip ok">✓</span><span>Status colour always paired with a word</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="demo-label">Keyboard contract</div>
        <table style="margin:0;">
          <tbody>
            <tr><td><span class="kbd">Tab</span> / <span class="kbd">Shift+Tab</span></td><td>Move through focusables in DOM order</td></tr>
            <tr><td><span class="kbd">Esc</span></td><td>Close the topmost overlay (modal, sheet, dropdown)</td></tr>
            <tr><td><span class="kbd">←</span> <span class="kbd">→</span> <span class="kbd">Home</span> <span class="kbd">End</span></td><td>Tabs, segmented controls, roving tabindex</td></tr>
            <tr><td><span class="kbd">Enter</span> / <span class="kbd">Space</span></td><td>Activate the focused control</td></tr>
            <tr><td><span class="kbd">⌘/Ctrl+Enter</span></td><td>Send the chat message</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <p style="margin:10px 0 0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">
          <strong>Focus contract:</strong> <code>outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary)</code>, offset 2px — or
          <code>ring-2 ring-primary/50</code>. Visible on both themes, never removed, never only on <code>:hover</code>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin:20px 0 8px;">Touch & motion</h3>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Touch</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">Targets ≥ 44×44px, 8px gaps, row actions always visible on touch (not hover-only).</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Motion</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);"><code>prefers-reduced-motion</code> disables every transition group, not only the mobile shell.</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><div class="demo-label">Zoom</div><p style="margin:0; font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2);">200% zoom without horizontal loss; text stays ≥ 14px in dense surfaces.</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══ Code ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="code">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">12</span><h2>Implement it</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">Five concrete steps, in order. Nothing here needs design input — it is safe to start today.</p>

    <div class="codeblock">

  <!-- ══ Do / Don't ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section id="dodont">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="num">13</span><h2>Do / Don't</h2></div>
    <p class="sub">The seven mistakes that were actually found in the codebase, as pairs.</p>

    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Use <code>#CC0099</code> for magenta and <code>#FF69B4</code> for magenta <em>text</em> on dark. One value per role.</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Introduce <code>#CC049C</code> (a 3/255 near-miss) or resurrect <code>#6366F1</code> indigo. Three palettes is how "brand colour" stops being a value.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Keep <code>radius.field</code> / <code>radius.box</code> / <code>radius.selector</code>. One radius per component.</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Mix 12px body + 8px header + pill button in one card. It reads as three objects.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Show every number with a unit and, in a column, tabular figures. <code>12.4k tokens</code> · <code>$0.42</code> · <code>2m 12s</code>.</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Write <code>12.4k</code>, <code>0.42</code>, <code>132 seconds</code> — or a UI string with no unit at all.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Pair status colour with a word or icon: <span class="badge success"><span class="dot on"></span>online</span></div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Use a bare green dot, a red border, or a magenta element to mean "error".</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Use <code>fa-solid</code> for UI chrome, <code>fa-regular</code> for soft nav and empty states — one set per surface.</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Mix Font Awesome and Iconify in one view; use emoji as UI icons; reuse <code>fa-comments</code> for both Chat and Messenger.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Design the panel <em>and</em> the route; give multi-instance apps a qualified title (<code>Tasks — Sprint 12</code>).</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">Ship a screen that only works with a 256px sidebar next to it — on mobile it becomes a headless page.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pair" style="margin-bottom:0;">
      <div class="do"><div class="h">✓ Do</div><div class="body">Write the error: <em>what failed · why · what to do next</em>, then keep the panel open.</div></div>
      <div class="dont"><div class="h">✕ Don't</div><div class="body">"Something went wrong." · "Error: [object Object]" · "Oops! 😢"</div></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  function syncToggle() {

    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', light ? 'true' : 'false');
  }
  syncToggle();
  if (toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var next = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      try { localStorage.setItem('cxj-playbook-theme', next); } catch (e) {}
      syncToggle();
    });
  }

  /* ── Copy to clipboard (swatches + code blocks) ────────────────────────── */
  function copyText(text, done) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, fallback);
    } else { fallback(); }
    function fallback() {
      var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text; ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');

      done();
    }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    var swatch = event.target.closest('.swatch[data-copy]');
    if (swatch) {
      copyText(swatch.getAttribute('data-copy'), function () {

      });
      return;
    }
    var btn = event.target.closest('.copybtn[data-copy]');
    if (btn) {
      copyText(btn.getAttribute('data-copy'), function () {
        var old = btn.textContent;
        btn.textContent = 'Copied';
        btn.classList.add('done');
        setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = old; btn.classList.remove('done'); }, 1400);
      });
    }
  });

  var layer = document.getElementById('modalLayer');
  var opener = document.getElementById('openModal');
  var closer = document.getElementById('closeModal');
  var cancel = document.getElementById('cancelModal');
  var box = layer ? layer.querySelector('.modal-box') : null;

  function openModal() {
    if (!layer) return;
    layer.classList.add('open');
    if (box) box.focus();
  }
  function closeModal() {
    if (!layer) return;
    layer.classList.remove('open');
    if (opener) opener.focus();
  }
  if (opener) opener.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  if (closer) closer.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  if (cancel) cancel.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  if (layer) {
    layer.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === layer) closeModal(); });
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && layer && layer.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
  });

  var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toc a[href^="#"]'));

        if (visible[id] > bestRatio) { bestRatio = visible[id]; best = id; }
      });
      links.forEach(function (a) {
        a.classList.toggle('active', best !== null && a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + best);
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '-72px 0px -55% 0px', threshold: [0, 0.15, 0.4, 0.75, 1] });
    sections.forEach(function (s) { observer.observe(s); });

  var themeBeforePrint = null;

    themeBeforePrint = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
  });

    if (themeBeforePrint) root.setAttribute('data-theme', themeBeforePrint);
  });

# codx-junior — Design Documentation

Corporate image and UI/UX foundation for **codx-junior**, derived from an audit of the
shipping product (`client/` — project `codx-junior-ui`).

> **Status:** v0.1 — *baseline definition*. Everything here describes either

## Why this folder exists

codx-junior grew feature-first: 400+ Vue components, several parallel shells
(desktop dockview, mobile app shell, company shell, solopreneur shell) and three
different colour palettes that leaked into the codebase over time. The product
works, but it does not yet look like *one company*.

This folder is the single place where the corporate image is defined, so that:

- a new screen can be designed without inventing new colours, spacing or copy;
- a designer and a developer can agree on a spec without a meeting;
- rebrand work (logo, palette, marketing site) has a contract to break *on purpose*.

---

| Folder | Contents | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `00-audit/` | What the current UI actually is, with file-level evidence | Designers, tech leads |
| `01-brand/` | Brand platform, logo, colour, typography, voice — the *corporate image* | Everyone, marketing included |
| `02-design-system/` | Foundations (space, radius, motion, layering) and component specs | Designers, frontend |
| `03-ux/` | Information architecture, navigation model, accessibility | Designers, PMs, frontend |
| `04-assets/` | Asset production rules: formats, sizes, naming, export | Design, marketing |
| `05-governance/` | Ownership, versioning, review checklist, adoption roadmap | Leads |
| `tokens/` | `design-tokens.json` — machine-readable source for the values above | Frontend |

Reading order for a newcomer: **audit → brand platform → colour → typography →
foundations → components → IA**.

# codx-junior — Design Documentation

Corporate image and UI/UX foundation for **codx-junior**, derived from an audit of the
shipping product (`client/` — project `codx-junior-ui`).

> **Status:** v0.1 — *baseline definition*. Everything here describes either
> (a) what the product does **today**, verified in code, or (b) a **decision
> proposal** to close a gap. Each statement is labelled so the two never get
> confused.

> **Start here — [`playbook/index.html`](playbook/index.html).** The whole design system on
> one self-contained page: live component specimens, dark/light toggle, print-ready layout.
> Hand it to any developer before they write UI code.

---

## Why this folder exists

codx-junior grew feature-first: 400+ Vue components, several parallel shells
(desktop dockview, mobile app shell, company shell, solopreneur shell) and three
different colour palettes that leaked into the codebase over time. The product
works, but it does not yet look like *one company*.

This folder is the single place where the corporate image is defined, so that:

- a new screen can be designed without inventing new colours, spacing or copy;
- a designer and a developer can agree on a spec without a meeting;
- rebrand work (logo, palette, marketing site) has a contract to break *on purpose*.

---

## How to read it

| Folder | Contents | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playbook/` | **The playbook** (`index.html`) — this whole folder on one page, with rendered specimens | Developers, new joiners |
| `resources/` | **Official artwork** — `logo.png` (the mark, 267 × 266 PNG + alpha) and `me-and-codx-junior.png` (brand photograph). Embedded by the playbook, taken from here, never re-exported | Everyone |
| `00-audit/` | What the current UI actually is, with file-level evidence | Designers, tech leads |
| `01-brand/` | Brand platform, logo, colour, typography, voice — the *corporate image* | Everyone, marketing included |
| `02-design-system/` | Foundations (space, radius, motion, layering) and component specs | Designers, frontend |
| `03-ux/` | Information architecture, navigation model, accessibility | Designers, PMs, frontend |
| `04-assets/` | Asset production rules: formats, sizes, naming, export | Design, marketing |
| `05-governance/` | Ownership, versioning, review checklist, adoption roadmap | Leads |
| `tokens/` | `design-tokens.json` — machine-readable source for the values above | Frontend |

Reading order for a newcomer: **audit → brand platform → colour → typography →
foundations → components → IA**.

---

## Ground rules

1. **The code is the current truth; this folder is the target truth.** When they
   disagree, the documents say which one wins.
2. **No new colour, radius or spacing value without a token.** If a value is
   missing, add a token here first, then use it.
3. **Every doc is versioned with the product**, not separately. See
   `05-governance/design-ops.md`.
4. **Numbers beat adjectives.** "16px, 8px grid, 4.5:1" is a spec; "modern and
   clean" is not.

---
