## One-paragraph summary of the brand (TL;DR)

**codx-junior** is an AI engineering companion for teams. It is calm, dense with
information and *fast to read*. Its corporate signature is a **magenta spectrum**
(`#CC0099` → `#FF69B4`) on a **deep blue-slate** canvas, with a **system UI
typeface** for the interface and a **monospace** for anything the machine said or

# Asset Guidelines

How brand assets are produced, named and exported — for product, docs, decks, social
and partner use.

---

## 1. Folder layout (create as assets land)

```
design/04-assets/
  logo/            vector lockups, glyph, colour variants (see 01-brand/logo-system.md)
  app-icons/       favicon set, PWA icons, store icons
  social/          OG image, LinkedIn/X cards, avatar
  product/         curated product screenshots (both themes, desktop + mobile)
  diagrams/        SVG architecture/flow diagrams
  templates/       deck, one-pager, doc header (source + export)
  fonts/           self-hosted webfonts, if a licensed face is adopted
```

Nothing goes in `client/public/` until it exists here first. `client/public/` is a
build artifact location, not an asset library.

---

## 2. Formats & rules

| Type | Master | Delivered | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logo | `.svg` (editable source + optimised export) | `.svg`, `.png` | Inline `fill`, no `<style>`, no embedded raster, no text-as-path unless the wordmark is fixed |
| Icons (product) | Font Awesome set (already vendored) | — | Do not add a second icon library per surface |
| Screenshots | PNG 2× (retina) | PNG or WebP | No device frames, no fake browser chrome, no blur |
| Illustrations | SVG | SVG/PNG | Line work, magenta family, dark canvas |
| Diagrams | Mermaid (in docs) or SVG | SVG | Consistent node styling, mono labels |
| Photography | — | — | **Not used.** No stock photography in the corporate image |
| Video | MP4/H.264 | MP4 + poster PNG | ≤ 30s loops, no audio, captions if spoken |

Naming: `codx-junior-<subject>-<variant>-<size>.<ext>`, lowercase, hyphenated,
no spaces, no dates. Examples:

```
codx-junior-logo-primary.svg
codx-junior-glyph-512.png
codx-junior-og-1200x630.png
codx-junior-screenshot-chat-dark-2x.png
codx-junior-screenshot-board-light-2x.png
codx-junior-diagram-harness-run.svg
```

---

## 3. Product screenshots (the primary marketing asset)

Because the product *is* the visual, screenshots carry the brand. Rules:

1. **Real product, real data.** No lorem ipsum, no `test test test`, no placeholder
   avatars. Use a believable project ("codx-junior platform", real file names).
2. **Both themes**, but dark is the hero shot.
3. **Window edges:** capture the app viewport only — no OS chrome, no rounded device
   frames, no drop shadows added afterwards.
4. **Crop to the story.** One screenshot = one message (chat streaming, board with
   sprint, diff review, live browser with handover).
5. **Redact** tokens, API keys, emails and personal names before publishing.
6. Export at 2× and let the consumer downscale; never upscale.
7. Keep a source set in `design/04-assets/product/` plus a manifest with the route used
   to reproduce each shot.

Current usable material: `docs/public/images/NOV2025/*.png` (banner, desktop, kanban,
profiles, pull request, knowledge, models) and `.mobile-preview/screenshots/01–10.png`.
They should be re-shot against the token-based theme once it ships — the current shots
show the untokened palette.

---

## 4. Avatars & user imagery

| Case | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Real user | Their uploaded image |
| No image | **Initials on `brand.magenta.600`** (white, 600 weight) — deterministic from the name |
| AI profile | Glyph mark on `surface.overlay` with a 1px `border.default`, or the profile's own avatar |
| Partner/brand | Monochrome version of their mark, equal optical weight |
| Never | Third-party avatar generators (today: `api.dicebear.com`), emoji faces, stock portraits |

---

## 4b. People photography (the supplied brand photograph)

`design/resources/me-and-codx-junior.png` (1028 × 1024, PNG, opaque) is the only approved
people photograph: real room, real people, no stock. The brand allows **one human moment per
surface** — landing page, About, talks, deck credit slides.

- Never inside the product UI; never as an avatar or a user's profile picture.
- No crop that removes a person, no filters, no AI retouching, no background removal.
- A signed model release is required before any external, paid or press use.
- A new photograph must follow the same brief and be registered in this file.

---

## 5. Iconography assets

- Source of truth: `client/src/assets/fontawesome-free-6.5.1-web` (FA 6.5.1 Free).
- App-level icons live in the registries (`config/apps.js`, `config/mobile.js`) as
  class strings — they are **design decisions**, so changes to them go through this
  folder's review, not a drive-by commit.
- For brand marks FA lacks (GitHub is present; marketplace logos may not be), export an
  optimised SVG into `design/04-assets/icons/` and consume it as a component.

---

## 6. Imagery don'ts (corporate image protection)

- ❌ Robotic hands, glowing brains, neural-network stock art, "AI orbs", 3D blobs.
- ❌ Purple-blue gradients unrelated to the magenta ramp (the "AI product" cliché).
- ❌ Memoji / mascots of any kind.
- ❌ Screenshots with invented features that do not exist in the product.
- ❌ Partner logos of unequal optical weight or with recoloured brand colours.
- ❌ Light-mode screenshots used to represent a dark-first product.

---

## 7. Export specs by channel

| Channel | Spec |
| --- | --- |
| Favicon | `favicon.ico` 16/32/48 + `favicon.svg` |
| Apple touch icon | 180×180 PNG, no transparency, radius baked 22.5% |
| PWA | 192 and 512 PNG (+ `maskable` 512 with 20% safe padding) |
| OG / link preview | 1200×630 PNG, logo top-left, one-line claim, dark canvas |
| GitHub social | 1280×640 PNG |
| Docs header | 1600×400 PNG or SVG, dark canvas |
| Deck | 16:9, title slide = logo on dark canvas, no image collage |
| Email signature | Horizontal lockup ≤ 240px wide, 1× and 2× |

---

## 8. Asset checklist
